summary: Phase 7 (MPCA-113/114/115/118/129) tested end-to-end — backend + frontend, both 100% passing. Backend pytest suite (8 tests) validates: (a) GET /sub-committees returns the 8 curated committees with member_count; (b) GET /sub-committees/SELECTION/members returns {code,label,count,members}; (c) POST /meetings with sub_committee_code='SELECTION' auto-expands attendees to include every SELECTION member's id; (d) documents[] and external_attendees[] persist through create + GET; (e) POST /events/birthdays/send-daily-emails returns {mocked, attempted, sent[]} — backend logs confirm '[EMAIL · MOCKED — no SMTP_HOST set]' entries for both meeting invitation dispatch AND birthday emails. Frontend Playwright walk-through: logged in as persona-chip-secretary, navigated /meetings/new — all Phase 7 testids present (subcommittee-section, mt-subcommittee-select, documents-section, doc-name-input/url/add, external-name/email/add). Selecting SELECTION shows subcommittee-preview live block. External attendee + PDF document attached, meeting saved, redirected to /meetings/{id}. MeetingDetail documents-section renders with doc-preview-open-{name} trigger — clicking opens doc-preview-modal with a PDF iframe (data-testid='doc-preview-iframe') and toolbar (newtab/download/close). Close button dismisses. /events shows event-type-filter with 6 options (All/Meetings/Tournaments/Announcements/Holidays/Other) and filter switching works. All test data cleaned up.
critical_code_review_comments: core/email_notifications.py cleanly gates on SMTP_HOST env; mocked path logs subject+recipients — good observability. Consider persisting the mocked entries into a `notifications` collection so the UI can show 'sent' audit history even in preview.

routes/meetings.py::create_meeting fires send_meeting_invitation for EVERY new meeting regardless of meeting_type — spec called out 'high-priority' meetings. Current behaviour is safe (mocked) but once SMTP is wired this will send an email on every low-stakes Sub-Committee draft. Recommend gating by meeting_type in {AGM, SGM, Committee} or by a `send_invitations` flag.

components/DocumentPreview.jsx uses `<iframe src={url}>` for anything ending in .pdf. If url ever lacks the .pdf extension (e.g. signed S3 URL with query string), it will fall to the 'other file types' branch. Consider also inspecting `?...` free of extension or a mime hint. Not blocking for MVP.

MeetingNew.jsx auto-fires send_meeting_invitation via POST /meetings even when attendees list is empty (external_attendees may still receive). This is correct today because send_email() no-ops on empty recipients, but the payload contains no explicit consent flag — worth documenting.
seed_data_creation: Created + DELETED test meetings (TEST_UI Phase7 Meeting, TEST_Phase7 Selection Meeting, TEST_Phase7 Plain). DB is clean.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 7 fully passing. SUB_COMMITTEES has 8 codes. Currently no members are tagged to any committee via positions.committee (Selection returned count=0 in prod DB — expected per spec note). Mocked-email log line format: '[EMAIL · MOCKED — no SMTP_HOST set] to=[...] subject=...'. DocumentPreview picks iframe vs img by lowercased extension match on the URL string.
